hypotheses.paper: Sigma a causally regular HS-sphere (N4 Setting, Thm tm:thierry type 1)
hypotheses.note: any (SO0(1,2), HS2)-manifold M (standing for Reg Sigma) carrying N4's annulus, GX.DSAnnulus. M is locally path-connected and semilocally simply connected because it is charted on HS2 (GX.semilocallySimplyConnected_of_chartedSpace_hs2), so no standing hypothesis is added

hypotheses.paper: only elliptic singularities; D+- discs carrying the particles
hypotheses.note: not used: Theta- = Theta+ concerns C+- and the annulus only

hypotheses.paper: A a regular de Sitter annulus joining C- = bd D- and C+ = bd D+
hypotheses.note: GX.DSAnnulus: C- a circle of past photons, C+ of future photons (GX.IsPhotonCircle), a continuous cover : R x [-1,1] -> M of period 1 in s, restricting on R x {-1}, R x {1} to periodic coverings E+- : R -> C+-; regular = M non-singular; de Sitter = every point of the closed annulus is a de Sitter point or a photon (hreg). That cover is a covering of an embedded annulus is not required

hypotheses.paper: Theta+- the angle of the RP1-circle C+- from the hyperbolic side (N4 l.341-343, BBS l.1900-1912)
hypotheses.note: GX.HasRealAngle for GX.IsPhotonCircle.rp1ChartedSpace (the strict reading of T-bbs-photon-circles, OQ-117 (c)); GTilde.angle = 2 pi tau
not needed: the holonomy of the annulus acts on R- and R+ by one h in G~ (GX.exists_gTilde_of_holonomy), so the lifted holonomies of C+- are h^(+-1), and real angles are >= 0

findings: Theta- = Theta+ does not need iota'_L (BBS l.2991-3004). The developing map of the annulus into dS~2 u R+- and its holonomy suffice. The holonomy acts on R- and R+ by one element h of G~, because iota_L is SO0(1,2)-equivariant and is the identity R- -> R+ in RP~1-coordinates (GX.exists_gTilde_of_holonomy, l.2983-2990). So C+- have lifted holonomies h or h^-1, and since real angles are >= 0 the two values agree (GX.DSAnnulus.IsDevelopment.theta_eq). The developing map itself is built from gx's developing theorem (GX.DSAnnulus.exists_isDevelopment). N4 (M3)'s real-angle half is therefore proved with no named hypothesis (GX.DSAnnulus.theta_eq_of_regular), for every regular de Sitter annulus of every HS-surface.

N4 l.348-349 « degree included »: for Theta > 0 the lifted holonomies of C- and C+ coincide (GX.DSAnnulus.hasLiftedHolonomy_iff_of_pos). For non-elliptic C+- the degrees agree (GX.DSAnnulus.degree_eq_of_regular). When Theta = 0 the parametrisations may give h and h^-1 (orientations differ); the formal statement then gives equal angles (0) and equal degrees, not equal lifted holonomies.
questions: N4's data (l.321-329) are read as GX.DSAnnulus (see hypotheses). The discs D+- do not enter Theta- = Theta+. Is an annulus covered by a strip, with boundary lines covering C+-, the intended reading of « a de Sitter annulus A joins C- and C+ »?

OQ-113: Theta- = Theta+ holds in every rescaling c tau of the angle. The lifted holonomies are h^(+-1) for one h, with h^-1 only when tau(h) = 0. Reading taken: GTilde.angle = 2 pi tau (OQ-113 (a)). The value of Theta (mass 1 - Theta/2pi, 0 < Theta < 2pi) is not stated.

labels.label: bbsrem:causally_regular_hs_sphere_containing

hypotheses.note: any HS-surface M (Reg Sigma) with N4's annulus GX.DSAnnulus, as for N4:M3-theta

hypotheses.paper: iota'_L : D~ u C~- u C~+ -> C~+, « an analogous proper submersion », and the commuting diagram (l.2991-3004)
hypotheses.note: the named hypothesis the dispatch allows, GX.DSAnnulus.IsIotaPrime: a developing map d into dS~2 u R+- (l.2971-2974, extended to C~+-), and a continuous iota' lifting a map of the closed annulus to C+ with d o iota' = iota~_L o d. Properness and the submersion property are not used. The model dS2 u bdH2+- satisfies it (GX.modelAnnulus_isIotaPrime). It is needed only when Theta = 0: for Theta- > 0 the remark is proved without it (GX.DSAnnulus.remark_projIso_of_pos)
a homeomorphism C- = C+ which is a (PSL(2,R), RP1)-morphism, its inverse too, for the structures from the hyperbolic side; « induced by iota'_L » is iota (E- s) = E+ (iota' (s, -1))
every statement is proved for both foliations epsilon = +-1 (OQ-117 (d) is immaterial here)

findings: The remark (l.3013-3016) has no proof of its own, and its one step is implicit. For iota'_L : C~- -> C~+ to induce a map C- -> C+, it must commute with the deck transformations. That follows because iota'_L lifts the leaf projection of the closed annulus and fixes C~+ (forced by the diagram), plus continuity on the connected strip (GX.DSAnnulus.IsIotaPrime.apply_add_one). A sentence would close it.

For Theta- > 0, in particular for elliptic C-, the remark needs no iota'_L. The holonomy h of the annulus then has no fixed point on RP~1, so d|C~+ is onto RP~1 (GX.surjective_of_equivariant). This is the step « d|C~+ is a homeomorphism » of l.3006, proved here for any RP1-circle whose holonomy has no fixed point. Then (d|C~+)^-1 o d|C~- induces the projective isomorphism (GX.DSAnnulus.remark_projIso_of_pos). In developed coordinates this map is iota'_L.

The diagram of l.2999-3003 has two typos. Its top-left corner reads « \tilde D\cup\tilde C_-\cup\tilde C » (l.3000) for D~ u C~- u C~+. Its bottom-right corner « \tilde R_+ » (l.3002) should be R_+, which is already the line ≅ RP~1 (l.2980-2981).
questions: Theta = 0 (C+- parabolic or hyperbolic of degree 0, e.g. the funnel of Lemma F): the remark is proved only under the named hypothesis. Reading taken: iota'_L is the paper's assumption there. The session's sketch [r], NOT evidence and not formalized: the developed images of C~+- are components of R minus Fix(h), matched by a power of delta, or by a lift of a quarter turn when the orientations differ. If so, the remark holds for every regular annulus with no iota'_L. Should this be a target?

The remark is filed under bucket D (« §7 AdS-specific », REVIEW §A row 48), but its content (dS~2, iota_L, photon circles) is § 5.1's HS2 geometry and lives in lean-gx. Should its bucket and scope note be revised?

kb_proposals: d~S2 u R+- is GX.DSTilde = R x [-1,1], projected onto dS2 u bdH2+- by GX.dsCover through the leaf chart GX.iotaChart. There iota~_L is (s,t) |-> (s,1) (GX.iotaTilde), and R- -> R+ is the identity in RP~1-coordinates (GX.dsCover_rMinus, GX.dsCover_rPlus). It is contractible, simply connected and locally path-connected (GXScaffold.Interaction.TheoremMTheta).

A lifted SO0(1,2)-equivariance of a map into d~S2 u R+- acts on the RP~1-coordinate by one element of G~, the same at every height t: GX.exists_gTilde_of_holonomy, via iota_smul and a continuous integer-valued function (GX.eq_of_continuous_int). Use it to compare the holonomies of R- and R+.

To develop a map of a simply connected space into an HS-surface M, lift it to M~ (IsCoveringMap.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts on UniversalCover.isCoveringMap_proj) and compose with gx's developing_theorem. Use GX.UniversalCover.exists_deck_apply_eq (the deck group is transitive on fibres) for the holonomy. GX.DSAnnulus.exists_isDevelopment is the template.

Every (G, HS2)-manifold is locally path-connected (ChartedSpace.locPathConnectedSpace (HS 2) M) and semilocally simply connected (GX.semilocallySimplyConnected_of_chartedSpace_hs2). Do not carry these as hypotheses on HS-surfaces.

The chart of IsPhotonCircle.rp1ChartedSpace at x, read through rp1ToBdMinus (past photons) or rp1ToBdPlus (future photons), is the HS-chart: GX.IsPhotonCircle.coe_rp1ToBdMinus_chartAt / coe_rp1ToBdPlus_chartAt. They settle hC.exists_bdPiece.choose through GX.coe_rp1ToBd_of_eq_false / _true (subst on a Bool equation).

Projectively isomorphic RP1-circles (a homeomorphism that is an IsGXMorphism PSL(2,R) RP1) have the same lifted holonomies and real angles: GX.hasLiftedHolonomy_iff_of_isGXMorphism, GX.hasRealAngle_iff_of_isGXMorphism. GX.exists_projIso_of_lift builds the isomorphism from a map phi of universal covers with phi(s+1) = phi s + 1 and D2 o phi = D1. Its surjectivity comes from mathlib's CircleDeg1Lift.continuous_iff_surjective.

Pitfall: with `have h1 : T := congrArg Prod.fst (h.comm z)`, the expected type T makes Lean unify f a1 = f a2 against T and fail when the right side is defeq but not syntactic, e.g. (iotaTilde w).1 against w.1. Write `have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst (h.comm z)` without a type and `exact` it.
notes: One new file, 1143 lines, 0 sorry, standard axioms only. It is clean under -DwarningAsError=true, so it can graduate as is. It imports GX.BBS.PhotonCircles only, and causal_import_gate is ok (DEC-33). `lake build GXScaffold.Interaction.TheoremMTheta` rebuilt only this module (4.6 s); nothing upstream moved. The scaffold root does not import it (kb/0025). It does not import TheoremM, FunnelGTilde or HSSingularities. Names were checked against GX/ and scaffold/ and do not clash. Scope relative to the dispatch: the planner expected Theta- = Theta+ from the named hypothesis on iota'_L. That route is done (GX.DSAnnulus.theta_eq, hasLiftedHolonomy_iff, IsIotaPrime.exists_projIso). In addition, Theta- = Theta+ is proved with NO named hypothesis: the developing map of the annulus is built from gx's developing theorem, and its holonomy suffices (GX.DSAnnulus.theta_eq_of_regular). The remark itself is proved without the hypothesis when Theta > 0, and under it in general. N4:M3-theta is partial only for the readings of N4's data (GX.DSAnnulus) and of the hyperbolic-side structure (OQ-117 (c)); no hypothesis is added. Pseudo-label N4:M3-theta is the real-angle half; T-3p1-theorem-m's N4:M3 row is the holonomy half.
